mapper.select: SELECT A.CODE_NO, S.CONTENT FROM SY_CODE A JOIN SY_CODE_PARAM SC ON SC.CODE_NO = A.CODE_NO AND SC.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} LEFT JOIN SY_GLOBAL_NAME S ON S.NO = A.CODE_NO AND S.LANGUAGE = #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE A.ACTIVITY = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SY_CODE C JOIN SY_CODE_PARAM P ON P.CODE_NO = C.CODE_NO AND P.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE C.PARENT_CODE_NO = 16413 AND C.ACTIVITY = 1 AND C.CODE_NO = A.PARENT_CODE_NO) ORDER BY A.PARENT_CODE_NO, A.ORDERNO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_PARAM (APPLY_PARAM_NO, REFERENCN_FLAG, REFERENCN_FROM_FLAG, REFERENCN_FROM_OFFSET, REFERENCN_FROM_RELATION, REFERENCN_TO_FLAG, REFERENCN_TO_OFFSET, REFERENCN_TO_RELATION, APPLY_TYPE, DUTY_NO, AFFIRM_LEVEL, ACTIVITY, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, CPNY_ID, LOW_LEVEL, HIGH_LEVEL, TYPE, EMP_TYPE) VALUES (ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_PARAM_SEQ.NEXTVAL, 1, 1, #{fromOffset, jdbcType=INTEGER}, '>', 0, #{toOffset, jdbcType=INTEGER}, '<=', #{applyType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dutyNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{affirmLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER}, 1, SYSDATE, #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{lowLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{highLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER}, 'ar', #{empType, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_PARAM SET REFERENCN_FLAG = 1, REFERENCN_FROM_FLAG = 1, REFERENCN_FROM_OFFSET = #{fromOffset, jdbcType=INTEGER}, REFERENCN_FROM_RELATION = '>', REFERENCN_TO_FLAG = 0, REFERENCN_TO_OFFSET = #{toOffset, jdbcType=INTEGER}, REFERENCN_TO_RELATION = '<=', APPLY_TYPE = #{applyType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EMP_TYPE = #{empType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DUTY_NO = #{dutyNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, AFFIRM_LEVEL = #{affirmLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER}, LOW_LEVEL = #{lowLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER}, HIGH_LEVEL = #{highLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER}, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE APPLY_PARAM_NO = #{applyParamNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TYPE = 'ar'
